properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM filtering parser for Microsoft Sentinel native Email Event table
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null), endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]), emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]), emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string='*', disabled:bool=false, pack:bool=false) {
  ASimEmailEventLogs
  | where not(disabled)
  | where isnull(starttime) or coalesce(EventStartTime, TimeGenerated) >= starttime
  | where isnull(endtime) or coalesce(EventEndTime, TimeGenerated) <= endtime
  | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
      or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
      or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
  | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0 or EmailFromAddress has_any (emailfromaddress_has_any)
  | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0
      or EmailToRecipients has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
      or EmailCCRecipients has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
      or EmailBCCRecipients has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
  | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0 or EmailSubject has_any (emailsubject_has_any)
  | where array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or EmailDirection in~ (emaildirection_in)
  | where array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0 or EmailDeliveryLocation in~ (emaildeliverylocation_in)
  | where eventresult == '*' or EventResult =~ eventresult
  | extend
      EventSchema = "EmailEvent",
      EventStartTime = coalesce(EventStartTime, TimeGenerated),
      EventEndTime = coalesce(EventEndTime, TimeGenerated),
      Dvc = coalesce(Dvc, DvcFQDN, DvcHostname, DvcIpAddr, DvcId, _ResourceId),
      Src = coalesce(Src, SrcFQDN, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcDvcId),
      Dst = coalesce(Dst, DstIpAddr),
      Rule = coalesce(RuleName, tostring(RuleNumber)),
      User = SrcUserName,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      DvcEntityKey = column_ifexists("DvcEntityKey", ""),
      AdditionalFields = iff(pack, AdditionalFields, dynamic({}))
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventUid, EventOriginalUid, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
      EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount, EventVendor, EventProduct, EventProductVersion,
      EventType, EventSubType, EventOriginalType, EventResult, EventSeverity,
      EventOriginalSeverity, EventResultDetails, EventOriginalResultDetails,
      EventMessage, EventReportUrl, EventOwner, AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields,
      Dvc, DvcIpAddr, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcFQDN, DvcDescription,
      DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcMacAddr, DvcZone, DvcOs, DvcOsVersion, DvcAction,
      DvcOriginalAction, DvcInterface, DvcScopeId, DvcScope, DvcEntityKey,
      SrcUserName, SrcUsernameType, SrcUserId, SrcUserIdType, SrcUserScopeId, SrcUserScope,
      SrcUserUpn, Src, SrcDvcId, SrcDvcScopeId, SrcDvcScope, SrcDvcIdType, SrcDeviceType,
      SrcHostname, SrcDomain, SrcDomainType, SrcFQDN, SrcDescription, SrcIsp,
      SrcGeoCountry, SrcGeoCity, SrcGeoRegion, SrcGeoLongitude, SrcGeoLatitude, SrcIpAddr,
      Dst, DstIpAddr, EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients, EmailBCCRecipients, EmailSubject,
      EmailSizeBytes, EmailUrlCount, EmailUrls, EmailFileCount, EmailFiles,
      EmailDirection, EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation, EmailLanguage,
      EmailProtocolName, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailFromAddress, EmailReplyToAddress,
      EmailMailFromDomain, EmailFromDomain, EmailReplyToDomain,
      EmailDmarcResult, EmailDmarcOriginalResult, EmailDmarcOverride, EmailDmarcPolicy,
      EmailSpfResult, EmailSpfOriginalResult, EmailDkimResult, EmailDkimOriginalResult,
      EmailDkimDomain, EmailDkimSignature, RuleName, RuleNumber, Rule, RuleDescription,
      ThreatId, ThreatName, ThreatCategory, ThreatOriginalCategory, ThreatRiskLevel,
      ThreatOriginalRiskLevel, ThreatIpAddr, ThreatField, ThreatConfidence, ThreatOriginalConfidence,
      ThreatIsActive, ThreatFirstReportedTime, ThreatLastReportedTime, IndicatorType,
      IndicatorAssociation, AttackTactics, AttackTechniques, AttackRemediationSteps, User, IpAddr
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any,
    emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in,
    emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult,
    disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
